signal: Foursquare became the primary POI provider for Mapbox and added Databricks Marketplace access, now with 550+ integrated partners

email.body1:
Rebecca, saw Foursquare become the primary POI provider for Mapbox and open data access through the Databricks Marketplace.

With 550-plus integrated partners, there is more co-sell pipeline than a team can activate by hand, and that gap is where partner-sourced revenue stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the ecosystem, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Foursquare's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rebecca, quick follow-up for Foursquare.

Every new alliance like Mapbox or Databricks adds co-sell targets faster than a partner team can cover them, so a lot of joint pipeline never gets worked. Most teams cannot say exactly how many co-sell meetings they need to hit the number.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them, plus where partner coverage is leaking?
email.body3:
Rebecca, last bit of proof for Foursquare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Foursquare's partner reply rate likely compares to other data platforms. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rebecca, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running co-sell across 550-plus partners is its own kind of full plate and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Foursquare either way.
